text:
sam: quick design question — thinking about the on-prem setup wizard: should the breadcrumb live above or below the probe progress? feels noisy right now when probes stream logs. anita: putting it above feels cleaner to me. users expect nav at the top. but we should collapse streaming logs by default and offer a "Show details" toggle. :toggle_on: michael: agree with anita. also CTA ordering: "Run probes" -> "Next" makes sense, but we sometimes auto-run probes on field change. might be confusing if "Next" appears while probes are running. elaine: accessibility note — if probes run automatically, the progress updates need an aria-live region with polite updates, and focus must not jump when the breadcrumb changes. sample: ```
Probe: 3/5 complete
``` sam: nice — so summary: breadcrumb top, collapsed logs, explicit CTA state when probes are running, aria-live for progress. one more UX nit: breadcrumb links currently look like primary actions — can we make them subtle? anita: yep change from link-blue to text-muted, keep chevrons but reduce weight. also add a small help icon with hover text: "Breadcrumb shows your current step; use back only for config changes." michael: +1. For timing: if auto-probe triggers on editing a CIDR field, debounce 700ms before firing to avoid flapping and to keep CTAs stable. ops-bot: deploy-check: probe service latency spike on staging during auto-probe load yesterday at 03:12 UTC, but no customer impact. logging id: abc123. elaine: one more — keyboard order: breadcrumb > main heading > controls > progress > details. ensure tab stops respect that. small screen: collapse breadcrumb into "Step 2 of 5" pill to save vertical space. sam: thanks — I'll update the mocks and push a tiny PR for colors/weights. adding a checklist for the dev handoff: 1) breadcrumb above, muted style 2) collapsed logs + show details 3) CTA states while probes run 4) aria-live updates 5) debounce 700ms on auto-probe 6) mobile pill. tagging @anita for final signoff. anita: sounds good — tag me on the PR and I'll quick UX QA. :thumbsup: michael: add a short copy tweak for the help tooltip — "Back will reset step-specific inputs" -> "Back returns to previous step; some fields may reset." sam: added to checklist. thanks everyone!
